gloss: to conform to; to be based on; to be suited to

definitions.gloss: to conform to, to be based on, to be suited to
definitions.explanation: To be in accordance with or adapted to a particular situation, reality, or standard. Takes に to mark the thing conformed to.

examples.japanese: {現実|げんじつ}に{即|そく}した{対策|たいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need measures that are suited to reality.

examples.japanese: {法律|ほうりつ}に{即|そく}して{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: Judge in accordance with the law.

examples.japanese: {時代|じだい}に{即|そく}した{教育|きょういく}カリキュラムに{改定|かいてい}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: The educational curriculum needs to be revised to suit the times.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{現実|げんじつ}に{即|そく}する (conform to reality)
・{時代|じだい}に{即|そく}する (suit the times)
・{法律|ほうりつ}に{即|そく}する (be in accordance with the law)
・{実態|じったい}に{即|そく}する (be based on the actual situation)

USAGE NOTES:
A formal verb most commonly seen in the た-form as {即|そく}した (modifying a noun) or the て-form {即|そく}して (as an adverbial phrase). The pattern ～に{即|そく}した means "suited to ~" or "based on ~." Rarely used in casual speech — {合|あ}う or {合|あ}わせる are more everyday alternatives.
